# Niamind

> Life moves better together.

Niamind is a platform where people help each other move forward in life through reflection, connection, and contribution.

It is not a mental health platform. It is not a social network. It is not a productivity tool. It exists to help people navigate life intentionally — alongside others who are doing the same.

Founded in Kampala, Uganda. Built for anyone navigating the quieter, harder parts of being human.

## What Niamind is

Niamind is built around one pattern:

> Reflect → Connect → Contribute → Move Forward

People reflect on where they are. They connect with others navigating similar territory. They contribute what they have learned. In doing so, they move forward — and help others do the same.

Mental health outcomes are a consequence of what happens on Niamind — not the positioning layer.

## Who it is for

Young professionals, broadly 25 to 38, who are doing well by most external measures and privately navigating a thinner inner life than they would like. Their social world has contracted. The conversations that used to hold the real version of them have gotten quieter.

They are not in crisis. They are not looking for therapy. They are looking for somewhere that takes their inner life seriously — and for people doing the same quiet, honest work on themselves.

## Platform layers

**Journey** — A private space for personal reflection. Notes, prompts, weekly intentions, and curated content matched to a member's focus areas. Works as a complete solo experience before community exists.

**Feed** — Populated by Spaces the member has actively joined and Niamind editorial content. Not infinite scroll. Has a natural endpoint. Success is measured by usefulness, not time spent.

**Spaces** — Ongoing communities organised around areas of life people are actively working on. Joined deliberately. Never pushed into a member's experience uninvited. Examples: Confidence, Relationships, Purpose, Entrepreneurship, Emotional Wellbeing, Grief and Loss, Parenting.

**Discussions** — The knowledge layer inside Spaces. Where lived experience becomes useful to others. Questions, reflections, resources, and honest stories.

**Connections** — Mutual, consent-based relationships. Not followers. Not an audience mechanic. Unlock messaging when accepted.

**Guidance Layer** — Verified professionals who earn marketplace visibility through community contribution. Every professional contributes free community sessions before accessing paying clients. Visibility reflects ongoing contribution, not fees paid.

**Community Economy** — Niacoin is the platform's internal currency. Used for Appreciation, paid experiences, Events, and partner contributions. Not crypto. Not earned through participation. Not a status mechanism.

**Trust System** — Slots are the professional visibility mechanism. Earned through community sessions. Cannot be purchased, gifted, or transferred. Visibility decays without ongoing contribution.

**Impact System** — Verified NGOs, hospitals, community programmes, and education initiatives listed on the platform. Contributions recorded on a public ledger. 7% platform fee retained for infrastructure. Everything else goes directly to the organisation.

## Core principles

These apply to every feature and every product decision:

- No follower counts
- No public popularity rankings
- No engagement leaderboards
- No gamification of personal growth
- No algorithmic attention competition
- Success is measured by usefulness to the member, not time spent on the platform
- Niamind surfaces when it has something to give — not when it wants something from you

> Complexity belongs to the system, not the member.

## Build status

| Layer | Status |
|---|---|
| Landing page and waitlist | In progress |
| Journey, Feed, Spaces, Discussions, Connections, Profiles | MVP — in development |
| Rooms, Events, Messaging | Phase 2 |
| Professional marketplace | Phase 2 |
| Niacoin and Appreciation | Phase 2 |
| Slots and Trust System | Phase 2 |
| Impact System and Partner Programmes | Phase 2 |
| Radio | Future |

## Revenue model

- Platform fee on paid professional sessions
- Platform fee on paid Events and Creator content
- 7% fee on partner programme contributions
- Corporate client access for professionals (Phase 2 — requires minimum community contribution threshold)

Niamind does not generate revenue when members spend more time scrolling. It generates revenue when members find enough value to participate more deeply. Value creation comes before value exchange.
